_doc: Spec purpose files: what each spec/use-case is meant to do, the loop it runs, and why the community takes each talent the model would otherwise mis-value (from loop_audit.py). Roles: enabler (the loop does not work without it), control (positioning/safety that keeps the loop running), safety (deaths/emergencies), throughput, sustain, utility, filler (cheapest legal path to a deeper talent - the model may legitimately pick a different filler), avoid (harms the loop). 'encoded' says how the reason is expressed in the manual effect files; sources are the guides the reason comes from.

feral-cat-dps.purpose: Raid: Shred from behind with powershifting (Furor + Wolfshead Helm) for energy; leveling: Claw/Rake from the front, Ferocious Bite, Bear form for hard pulls.
loop: raid: Shred, Shred, Rip/Ferocious Bite, powershift when energy is empty
leveling: Claw x3-4, Ferocious Bite, Rake on runners, shift to Bear when three mobs come
constraints: Balance tier 1 (Nature's Grasp + Improved Nature's Grasp or Improved Wrath) is only a path to Natural Weapons and Omen of Clarity
leveling cats cannot rely on Shred positioning: Claw is the builder (model: profile_overrides), so Savage Fury and Ferocity matter more while leveling than in raids
Thick Hide / Feline Swiftness / Primal Fury in the raid build are tier fillers (Primal Fury is Bear-only rage in Classic)

Nature's Grasp.why: Balance tier-1 path to Natural Weapons/Omen of Clarity; roots on hit while leveling.

Thick Hide.why: Cat raid filler; real mitigation for Bear.

Feline Swiftness.why: Outdoor cat speed while leveling; raid filler.

Primal Fury.why: Bear-only rage on crits in Classic: cat raid filler on the way down the tree.

Ferocity.why: Cheaper Claw/Rake/Maul/Swipe: matters when Claw is the builder (leveling) and for Bear; raid cats Shred.
Ferocity.encoded: parsed resource cost with leveling Claw share

Savage Fury.why: Claw/Rake/Maul/Swipe damage: the leveling builder and the Bear rotation.

Furor.why: 40 energy on cat shift: the powershifting engine with Wolfshead Helm in raids; 10 rage for Bear pulls.

Improved Shred.why: Cheaper Shred: the raid builder; while leveling Shred is only used on stunned/rooted mobs, so its value is small there.
Improved Shred.encoded: parsed resource cost (Shred share is lower in leveling profiles)

Blood Frenzy.why: Forever name of Primal Fury (renamed Blood Frenzy in beta build 1.60.1.70009). Bear-only rage on crits in Classic: cat raid filler on the way down the tree.

Leader of the Pack.why: Brings leader of the pack to 4 others (a party aura: the feral druid sits in a melee group of four others); worth classic-era: +2.0% per receiver, forever: +2.0% per receiver (buff_value.py).

feral-bear-tank.purpose: Maul spam with Swipe on packs; armor from Dire Bear form and Thick Hide; rage from being hit, Furor and Primal Fury.
constraints: Balance tier 1 fillers (Nature's Grasp) are the path to Natural Weapons and Omen of Clarity

Leader of the Pack.why: Brings leader of the pack to 4 others (a party aura: the feral druid sits in a melee group of four others); worth classic-era: +2.0% per receiver, forever: +2.0% per receiver (buff_value.py).

Genesis.why: +5% periodic damage and healing (beta): the Forever bear draft's Balance tier-1 path; a bear has no periodic damage worth the points.

Moonglow.why: -25% spell mana: the Forever bear draft's Balance tier-2 path (three points); cheaper heals between pulls, nothing while tanking.

balance-dps.purpose: Moonkin: Starfire with Nature's Grace, Moonkin Aura for casters; Restoration dip for Nature's Focus/Subtlety threat and Insect Swarm.
constraints: Improved Thorns / Nature's Reach are tier fillers; Nature's Focus / Subtlety are threat and pushback utility

Improved Thorns.why: Balance tier-3 filler; small threat on the tank's Thorns.
Improved Thorns.encoded: dmg on the bear Thorns source only

Nature's Focus.why: Pushback on heals: healer-side utility of the dip.

Moonkin Form.why: Brings moonkin aura to 4 others (a party aura: the moonkin sits in a caster group of four others); worth classic-era: +2.4% per receiver, forever: +2.4% per receiver (buff_value.py).

Reflection.why: 50% of mana regeneration continues while casting: the moonkin's mana talent on the Restoration path to Insect Swarm; the healer lab measures 35% healing capacity for it on a resto druid (2026-09-26), the raid model scores it as regen x regen_share.

resto-heal.purpose: HoT-based healer: Rejuvenation/Regrowth with Swiftmend, Healing Touch downranked; Innervate.
constraints: Improved Wrath 5 is the leftover-points filler (dungeon damage); Improved Mark of the Wild is a raid buff; Subtlety/Nature's Focus are threat/pushback

Improved Wrath.why: Five leftover points: faster Wrath for soloing/dungeons.

Nature's Focus.why: Pushback resistance on Healing Touch/Regrowth when hit.

Nature's Grace.why: The point of the Regrowth build: Improved Regrowth crits proc Nature's Grace, which shortens the next Healing Touch/Regrowth by 0.5s.

Natural Shapeshifter.why: Balance tier-2 path to Nature's Grace (21 Balance points); cheaper shifts in dungeons.

Improved Entangling Roots.why: Balance tier-2 path to Nature's Grace.

Tranquil Spirit.why: -10% Healing Touch and Tranquility mana (beta); the healer lab measures 10% healing capacity (2026-09-26): a mana-bound raid healer's talent.

Improved Regrowth.why: +10%/rank Regrowth crit: Regrowth is the resto druid's fast heal; the healer lab measures 2.2% healing capacity (2026-09-26), the Swiftmend build's Restoration tier-5 path.
